skill.name: bilibili-content-research
skill.description: 当用户需要做 B站视频分析、爆款拆解、选题参考、竞品视频对比、趋势判断或素材整理时使用；需要时也可补充专栏结果。面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Sample public Bilibili videos and articles to compare titles, topics, and engagement.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, provider links, or readable Chinese text. The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package that can access an API key from the environment or a local credential file. The instructions also lack safeguards for shell arguments and paid requests; no evidence of prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: The CLI setup and search commands run an unpinned npm package that handles credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed release pinned by version and integrity hash. Separate installation from runtime, require approval for updates, and give the runtime only the credentials it needs.

remediation.issue: The documented CLI can read a persistently stored API key.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an approved secret manager over a JSON file. If file storage remains, verify restrictive permissions, document key removal and rotation, and keep credential values out of output.

remediation.issue: The shell examples do not specify how to pass untrusted keywords safely.
remediation.suggestion: Use structured MCP parameters or pass the keyword as a separate process argument without shell evaluation. Apply the same rule to continuation tokens.

remediation.issue: Credit use and payment links lack explicit authorization and verification rules.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm a credit limit before billable requests and enforce it across pages and retries. Use a fixed billing URL on the verified provider origin instead of a response-supplied link.

content.value_statement: Comparing Bilibili search results by hand makes it hard to track titles, sources, and engagement. This skill gathers a defined sample and summarizes patterns with links or content IDs.
actual_capabilities: Search public Bilibili videos and articles by keyword through separate SocialDataX search tools.
Sort videos by views, recency, on-screen comments, or saves when the search tool supports those options.
Filter video results by publication period and duration.
Set page and item limits, and preserve partial results when a search stops early.
Report available titles, creators, engagement counts, dates, links, and content IDs.
Summarize title framing, content angles, and ideas for follow-up research.
limitations: Live searches require an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or a configured CLI. Searches may consume service credits.
Results cover only the keywords, filters, and pages requested. The search cannot guarantee complete Bilibili coverage.
The search tools do not provide video transcripts or private account analytics.
Publication period and duration filters apply to videos, not articles.

use_cases.title: Plan a tutorial series
use_cases.description: Compare titles and audience questions in a small video sample before choosing topics for new tutorials.

use_cases.title: Compare competing brands
use_cases.description: Search each brand under the same video filters and compare title framing and available engagement counts.

use_cases.title: Track emerging topics
use_cases.description: Review recent videos and a separate article sample to identify topics for the next editorial planning cycle.

prompt_templates.title: Find a video sample
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: One keyword and one page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Bilibili for one page of videos about mechanical keyboards. List up to five titles with creators and links. Mark any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Review recent short tutorials
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Video filters and title analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to ten Bilibili videos about phone photography from the past week and under ten minutes. Sort by views and explain how the titles frame each topic.

prompt_templates.title: Compare videos and articles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Bilibili for one page each of videos and articles about desk organization. Compare the topics and title framing separately, and note differences in available engagement metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Benchmark two channels
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Matched queries with credit and sample limits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm my credit budget before searching for videos from two Bilibili channels I name. Use the same time window and sort order, with at most ten results per channel. Label partial results, include links, and separate observations from recommendations.

output_examples.input: Find one page of recent videos about beginner desk setups and suggest a topic.
output: Illustrative result: Two of five sampled titles put a budget in the headline. One result did not include a view count.
Suggested topic: Compare two desk layouts at the same price. Check a second keyword before deciding whether this pattern extends beyond the sample.

output_examples.input: Compare one page of videos and one page of articles about balcony gardening.
output: Illustrative result: The video sample focuses on container setup. The article sample covers plant choices for different light conditions.
The two samples use different engagement metrics, so compare topics separately from popularity.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on sample and credit limits before expanding the search.
Keep keywords, filters, and sorting consistent when comparing brands or accounts.
Keep source links or content IDs and flag missing fields, partial results, and sample limits.
anti_patterns: Treating a small or highly ranked sample as representative of all Bilibili content.
Pasting API keys, credential files, or private research terms into chat or command examples.
Running an unreviewed CLI release or restarting a partial search without checking the remaining limits.

faq.question: What does the skill search?
faq.answer: It searches public Bilibili videos and articles through separate SocialDataX tools.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials without a separate local key.

faq.question: Can searches consume credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Confirm a credit budget before searching and verify billing links through your SocialDataX account before paying.

faq.question: Can it analyze the full content of a video?
faq.answer: It analyzes titles and other returned metadata. The documented search tools do not watch videos or retrieve transcripts.

faq.question: Can it post or change my Bilibili account?
faq.answer: No. The documented tools search public content and do not post, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: What happens when a search stops early?
faq.answer: The skill keeps returned items and labels the sample incomplete. It can resume within the original limits when a valid continuation token is available.
